disposition_reason: Pb, Cd, As and Hg were measured by AAS in 16 commercial drinks from Awka, with per-sample values in mg/L in Table 1.

study.design: Retail survey of 16 commercial drinks of four brands with health risk assessment and PAH analysis
study.market: retail outlets, Awka, Anambra State, Nigeria
study.method: HNO3 hotplate digestion of 50 mL; AAS (Solaar SE 7190)
study.qa: Calibration curves only; no CRM, recovery or blanks reported

material.label_as_printed: Commercial soft drinks (soda, malt-based non-alcoholic drink or yoghurt drink; type per sample not stated)

unresolved: Which samples are soda, malt drink or yoghurt is not stated, so no sample can be assigned to a soft-drink subtype (cola, lemon-lime, diet, sports).
No LOD stated; BDL non-detects cannot be bounded.
Text range maximum for Pb (2.9653 mg/l) differs from Table 1 (2.9153).
Lead up to 2.9 mg/L is extremely high for commercial drinks and there is no analytical QA.
PDF header prints volume 9(1) (2021) 1-9; manifest year 2020.
